notes.title: Polishing Out Episode 1 + Added Swappable Scenes
notes.content: [p]Updated yesterday with some polishing for Episode 1, as well as added some more swappable scenes for Arcade mode![/p][p][/p][p]Seraphine now has Morgana's subdue animation, as well as Judi's caught sequence![/p][p][/p][p]We'll make a devlog soon with a roadmap for HH, and its future episodes, so we hope you'll all be excited for that![/p]

notes.title: Episode 1, Part 2 Is Now Live!
notes.content: [p]We still intend to polish out a few things, add more variances in the animation, and possibly extend it a bit as well, but here's our ending of Episode 1 of HH, enjoy! We look forward to the future episodes expanding on the lore of the HH Universe. [/p][p][/p][p]Part 2 more-so finalizes Episode 1 of HH, it's not as long as Part 1, however, it does have 2 h-scenes that are back-to-back, so keep that in mind! We'll add in some better checkpoints, add some variations in the h-scenes, and make the boss fight better as the updates progress.[/p]

notes.title: Waiting on some lines, Part 2 coming out soon!
notes.content: [p]Part 2 is mostly finished, we're just waiting on some lines from our VAs as a result of a last-minute commission we needed to make due to some changes in Part 2. The current update is just to update the text for the release window in-game, so if you're reading this, there's no need to update just yet. Our time-table is 1 week until we get the lines after some back and forth, so get excited! (We won't give a specified date this time so there won't be disappointment if it ends up being a day or two later and we have to write another "delay" patch note, which we'd like to stop doing!)[/p][p][/p][p][b]Important:[/b] After some weeks, we'll have a beta of another game we've been crafting in the background to be worked on in dual-development with HH that'll be available through our Discord. Progress on HH will be the same, and perhaps faster, so don't worry about it slowing down future episodes! This is primarily so we don't get burnt-out and can use some other ideas we've been having and implement them in HH as well if they're compatible.[/p]

notes.title: QUICK HOTFIX - Showing "Already Bought" if a player hasn't bought the item yet.
notes.content: Luckily this patch is <30MB! Some were experiencing not being able to purchase an item, receiving the message "Already Bought Item", despite not having it.

notes.title: Extending Ep.1 Part 2 release date to July 15th, Swapple H Scenes Update June 28
notes.content: [p]After many obstacles over the past 3 weeks—primarily dealing with business and tax matters we've never had experience with, which brought plenty of headaches and confusion—everything has now been sorted! Additionally, we've had a single nagging, game-breaking, bug in Part 2 that we've spent 2 weeks trying to figure out how to resolve, that yesterday we were finally able fix. [/p][p][/p][p]With these obstacles we're back on track with Part 2, however, we ask for 3 more weeks (July 15th), as of writing this, to allow us to finish all of Part 2, and make it great! As a thank-you for your patience, we’ll be releasing an update on June 28th that adds swappable H-scenes![/p]

notes.title: Crash Patch v2 + News on Next Update + Ability to Skip Intro of Episode 1
notes.content:
In the last Crash Patch, some users were experiencing the game crashing loading the Story Mode environment. We lowered the amount of VRAM and RAM that was taken up while switching between the intro of Episode 1 to the Carnival scene, by changing how we loaded it in. And this worked for some users, however, it still wasn't enough for some others. So in this update, after tinkering around, we've been able to reduce the RAM and VRAM of the carnival by around ~25%, which should fix it for the rest, we hope you all enjoy!

[b]HOW TO SKIP THE INTRO:[/b] Additionally, for those that were crashing beforehand, you won't need to go through the intro of Episode 1 again, after pressing "Play Story" once the game loads, simply press K on your keyboard, and it'll skip the introduction!

[b]News On The Next Update:[/b] We intend to add swappable XXX scenes soon for Arcade Mode, before Episode 1 fully comes out June 26th, though we're not too sure when it'll be, between 1-2 weeks from now would be our estimate for this ability, so stayed tuned!

notes.title: Crash Fixes for Episode 1 + Other Hotfixes
notes.content: We changed the way we load in scenes to be less taxing on the computer and VRAM, as some players have reported crashing on loading the Carnival environment. We hope this helps, enjoy!

notes.title: Episode 1, Part 1 is LIVE!
notes.content: Episode 1, Part 1 (of 2) is LIVE! This includes some bugfixes, as well as adds a decent chunk of more content to Story Mode Episode 1. We hope everyone enjoys!

notes.title: Better Localization + Fixing Possible Crashes People Have Had Between Scenes
notes.content:
Better Localization + There have been some reports of crashes loading between scenes, we hope this update will fix this for those encountering those issues!

We hope this will be the last update from us for at least a few days, we're sorry there have been quite a few since launch! This won't become a habit.

We are VERY sorry especially to our Chinese, Russian, and the many other language users who hadn't had subtitles for the Story Mode cutscenes on initial launch, this was a very problematic oversight on our behalf, and it won't happen again. Localization will ALWAYS be a #1 priority for us moving forward. We intend to localize the Shopkeeper's quips in an update coming soon, as well!

notes.title: H Scene Fix + Localization Improvements
notes.content: H-Scene bugfix between the Shopkeeper and Seraphine, and some localization improvements, particularly for Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), and Japanese, for the Story Mode.

notes.title: HOTFIX 0.2.1 - Content Patch
notes.content: The new update has the beginning of Episode 1 content patch, as well as major optimization improvements, and the bug fix with the Customization menu! We're very sorry it came a few hours after release, we had some issues on our end. We hope you all enjoy it, and thank you for playing Haunting Havens and supporting its future!

notes.title: Haunting Havens is REALEASED!
notes.content: Haunting Havens is now out! There will be a patch rolling out today at 3:00 P.M. PDT/PST, that'll include the beginning of Episode 1, and a patch for the Character Customization leading to a black screen for XXX scenes! Until that patch rolls out in a few hours, we recommend not using the Customization menu until then, we're extremely sorry for this! All XXX scenes are available in the current game mode, as of right now, we hope you enjoy Haunting Havens and its future progress!
